correctness.rationale: From the actual vector field independent expansion gives P-dot=y(y+b), div F=2y and weighted divergence -2y^2 rho/b, for rho=exp[-2P/b]. For b<0 every bounded-forward B_R is measurable, finite weighted mass and forward invariant. Its positive measure would force a STRICT change-of-variables weighted expansion at any T>0 since y(0)!=0 a.e.; contradicts inclusion phi_T(B_R) subset B_R. The union over integer R is null. At b=0 P monotonic and bounded complete alpha/omega limit sets force y=x=z=0; hence all bounded forward orbits tend to origin and no other compact two-sided invariant sets exist. Invariance of compactly supported probabilities and E[y^2]=-bE[y] gives Var(y)=-m(m+b); endpoint rigidity gives E0/Eb. Strictness is for positive-volume sets, not pointwise equilibria.
